mapper.select: SELECT FROM PET_PRTC_MTCH T WHERE T.PET_PRTC_MTCH_SN = #{petPrtcMtchSn} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM PET_PRTC_MTCH T WHERE T.OTO_CHAT_ROOM_SN = #{otoChatRoomSn} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM PET_PRTC_MTCH T WHERE T.IDMPT_DMND_ID = #{idmptDmndId} FOR SHARE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PET_PRTC_MTCH ( PET_PRTC_RCRT_SN , OTO_CHAT_ROOM_SN , MTCH_DLNG_STTS_CD , IDMPT_DMND_ID , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( #{petPrtcRcrtSn} , #{otoChatRoomSn} , #{mtchDlngSttsCd} , #{idmptDmndId} , NOW() , NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT V.MTCH_CND_VER_SN , V.PET_PRTC_MTCH_SN , V.MBR_SN , V.CST_UNIT_CD , V.CND_VER_NO , V.ACRD_CST_AMT , V.ACRD_PRTC_CN , V.ACRD_PRTC_BGNG_DT , V.ACRD_PRTC_END_DT , V.SCHDL_CNSLTN_PSBLTY_YN , V.REG_DT FROM MTCH_CND_VER V WHERE V.PET_PRTC_MTCH_SN = #{petPrtcMtchSn} ORDER BY V.CND_VER_NO DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(V.CND_VER_NO), 0) + 1 FROM MTCH_CND_VER V WHERE V.PET_PRTC_MTCH_SN = #{petPrtcMtchSn} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM PRTC_CMPTN_DMND_CYCL D WHERE D.PET_PRTC_MTCH_SN = #{petPrtcMtchSn} ORDER BY D.DMND_CYCL
SELECT FROM PRTC_CMPTN_DMND_CYCL D WHERE D.PET_PRTC_MTCH_SN = #{petPrtcMtchSn} ORDER BY D.DMND_CYCL DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(D.DMND_CYCL), 0) + 1 FROM PRTC_CMPTN_DMND_CYCL D WHERE D.PET_PRTC_MTCH_SN = #{petPrtcMtchSn} FOR UPDATE

SELECT T.PET_PRTC_MTCH_SN , C.CTPT_MBR_SN , M.MBR_NCNM AS CTPT_NCNM , T.MTCH_DLNG_STTS_CD , CASE T.RCV_YN WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 WHEN 'N' THEN 0 END AS RCV_YN , T.RCV_IDNTY_DT , T.REG_DT FROM PET_PRTC_MTCH T JOIN OTO_CHAT_ROOM C ON C.OTO_CHAT_ROOM_SN = T.OTO_CHAT_ROOM_SN LEFT JOIN MBR M ON M.MBR_SN = C.CTPT_MBR_SN WHERE T.PET_PRTC_RCRT_SN = #{petPrtcRcrtSn} ORDER BY T.REG_DT DESC , T.PET_PRTC_MTCH_SN DESC

SELECT V.PET_PRTC_MTCH_SN , V.CND_VER_NO , V.CST_UNIT_CD , V.ACRD_CST_AMT , V.ACRD_PRTC_CN , V.ACRD_PRTC_BGNG_DT , V.ACRD_PRTC_END_DT , V.REG_DT FROM MTCH_CND_VER V JOIN PET_PRTC_MTCH T ON T.PET_PRTC_MTCH_SN = V.PET_PRTC_MTCH_SN WHERE T.PET_PRTC_RCRT_SN = #{petPrtcRcrtSn} ORDER BY V.PET_PRTC_MTCH_SN , V.CND_VER_NO DESC

SELECT H.PET_PRTC_MTCH_SN , H.BFR_STTS_CD , H.AFTR_STTS_CD , V.CND_VER_NO , H.CHG_RSN , H.REG_DT FROM PET_PRTC_MTCH_STTS_HSTRY H JOIN PET_PRTC_MTCH T ON T.PET_PRTC_MTCH_SN = H.PET_PRTC_MTCH_SN LEFT JOIN MTCH_CND_VER V ON V.MTCH_CND_VER_SN = H.MTCH_CND_VER_SN WHERE T.PET_PRTC_RCRT_SN = #{petPrtcRcrtSn} ORDER BY H.PET_PRTC_MTCH_SN , H.REG_DT , H.PET_PRTC_MTCH_STTS_HSTRY_SN

SELECT D.PET_PRTC_MTCH_SN , D.PRTC_CMPTN_DMND_CYCL_SN , D.DMND_CYCL , D.CMPTN_CN , D.SPCL_MTTR_CN , D.PRTC_END_DT , D.PRTCR_IDNTY_RSLT_CD , D.PRTCR_IDNTY_DT , D.SPLMNT_DMND_RSN , D.REG_DT FROM PRTC_CMPTN_DMND_CYCL D JOIN PET_PRTC_MTCH T ON T.PET_PRTC_MTCH_SN = D.PET_PRTC_MTCH_SN WHERE T.PET_PRTC_RCRT_SN = #{petPrtcRcrtSn} ORDER BY D.PET_PRTC_MTCH_SN , D.DMND_CYCL

SELECT F.PRTC_CMPTN_DMND_CYCL_SN , F.ATCH_FILE_SN , F.SORT_SEQ FROM PRTC_CMPTN_PHOTO F JOIN PRTC_CMPTN_DMND_CYCL D ON D.PRTC_CMPTN_DMND_CYCL_SN = F.PRTC_CMPTN_DMND_CYCL_SN JOIN PET_PRTC_MTCH T ON T.PET_PRTC_MTCH_SN = D.PET_PRTC_MTCH_SN WHERE T.PET_PRTC_RCRT_SN = #{petPrtcRcrtSn} ORDER BY F.PRTC_CMPTN_DMND_CYCL_SN , F.SORT_SEQ , F.PRTC_CMPTN_PHOTO_SN
